requiredBehaviors.evidence: The mapping workflow starts from each role criterion and requires a separate assessment state per criterion.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve claim provenance for every assessment
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Every positive or negative mapping must retain supporting and contradicting claim references, with traceability through capability to source.
The assessment model defines distinct strongly-evidenced and partially-evidenced states with different evidentiary thresholds.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route unresolved gaps by gap type
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Research, interview, reference and role-definition gaps are typed separately and routed to the appropriate upstream or downstream capability.
The skill explicitly prohibits numeric, ordinal and implicit overall candidate scores or rankings.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: rank or recommend the candidate for hire
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Candidate ranking and hire recommendations are explicitly outside the decision boundary.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent person facts not present in the professional profile
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill prohibits creating new person facts and routes missing evidence back to professional-person-research.
